scientific_integrity: Algebraic theorem, analytic transcendental spectrum proof; numerical checker is not a certificate for the infinite-dimensional problem.
scientific_limitations: Identical kinetic and paired delay parameters, plus R>1, are assumed.
Linearized antisymmetric rate only, not a global nonlinear convergence or stochastic-fixation rate.
Other literature may contain unindexed analogous results.
title: Neutral strain continua and sharp exchange damping in a delayed two-virus model
